correctness.rationale: For the explicit GP(10,2) edge set the Hamiltonian is exactly J times the equal-edge count minus h times the color-0 occupancy. A ten-inner-site enumeration with a min-plus outer-decagon recurrence exhausts all 3^20 labeled configurations without double counting, tracking tie multiplicities. An independently constructed outer-decagon enumeration and two disjoint inner-pentagon convolution reproduces every one of the 21 integer sector minima and multiplicities. Their common sector table proves the lower envelope for all real h/J; exact rational checks verify all transition occupancy sets and counts. The proof is finite and does not extrapolate from sampled sizes.

value.rationale: The regular dodecahedron is a canonical finite 20-site Platonic spin system. Its three-state antiferromagnetic field response asks a natural observable beyond the known chromatic polynomial: exact favored-color occupation plateaux, field-induced nonproper ground states, and full coexistence multiplicities. The asymmetric thresholds -1,0,3/2,3 (in J units), and the 98770, 32320, 212905 nonzero-field coexistence counts are substantive exact structural information for this model, not a parameter renaming or trivial one-edge calculation. No infinite-family claim is needed for the natural complete finite classification.
